*** Add File: collect_platform_metadata.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def collect_platform_metadata(prompt: str, model: str = "gpt-4.1-mini") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model=model,
+        input=prompt,
+    )
+    output_text = getattr(response, "output_text", None)
+    if output_text is None:
+        output_text = "".join(
+            getattr(item, "text", "")
+            for item in getattr(response, "output", [])
+            for content in getattr(item, "content", [])
+            if getattr(content, "type", None) == "output_text"
+        )
+    usage = getattr(response, "usage", None)
+    metadata = {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": model,
+        "response_id": getattr(response, "id", None),
+        "output": output_text,
+        "usage": {
+            "input_tokens": getattr(usage, "input_tokens", None) if usage else None,
+            "output_tokens": getattr(usage, "output_tokens", None) if usage else None,
+            "total_tokens": getattr(usage, "total_tokens", None) if usage else None,
+        },
+        "model_handle": getattr(response, "model", None),
+    }
+    return metadata
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Iterator, Any
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+MODEL_ID = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini")
+
+
+def stream_generation(prompt: str) -> Iterator[Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    with client.responses.stream(model=MODEL_ID, input=prompt) as stream:
+        for event in stream:
+            yield event
+        yield stream.get_final_response()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    prompt = os.getenv("PROMPT", "Hello")
+    for item in stream_generation(prompt):
+        print(item)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PlatformResource:
+    provider: str
+    resource_id: str
+    resource_type: str
+
+
+class ResourceResolutionError(ValueError):
+    pass
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+    deployment: Optional[str] = None,
+    inference_resource: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> PlatformResource:
+    azure_endpoint = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT")
+    azure_deployment = deployment or os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")
+    azure_model = model or os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_MODEL") or "gpt-4.1-mini"
+    azure_resource = inference_resource or os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_RESOURCE")
+
+    if azure_deployment:
+        return PlatformResource(
+            provider="azure-openai",
+            resource_id=azure_deployment,
+            resource_type="deployment",
+        )
+
+    if azure_resource:
+        return PlatformResource(
+            provider="azure-openai",
+            resource_id=azure_resource,
+            resource_type="inference_resource",
+        )
+
+    if azure_endpoint:
+        return PlatformResource(
+            provider="azure-openai",
+            resource_id=azure_model,
+            resource_type="model",
+        )
+
+    raise ResourceResolutionError(
+        "Unable to resolve a provider-specific resource. Set AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT, AZURE_OPENAI_RESOURCE, or AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT."
+    )
*** End Patch

+import os
+
+from anthropic import Anthropic
+
+
+def invoke_platform_model(prompt: str) -> str:
+    client = Anthropic(api_key=os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.messages.create(
+        model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
+        max_tokens=256,
+        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
+    )
+    text_parts = []
+    for block in response.content:
+        if getattr(block, "type", None) == "text":
+            text_parts.append(block.text)
+    return "".join(text_parts)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(invoke_platform_model("Say hello in one short sentence."))
*** End Patch
